name: Shoppable
description: Shoppable's MCP Server is the first universal checkout integration built for AI assistants. Connect to a catalog of 500 million+ products across hundreds of merchants, search by keyword, category, price, or brand, and get real product details and pricing in real time. When you're ready to buy, you'll receive a checkout link, then complete your purchase on Shoppable with our patented multi-retailer universal checkout. No redirecting to multiple websites. No hunting. Shoppable makes online shopping simple.

tool.name: search_products
tool.title: Search Products
tool.description: Search Shoppable's product catalog by keyword, brand, or category. Returns a JSON payload with id, name, brand, category, price, salePrice, merchant, image, and a pre-built checkoutUrl for each result. Use the product ID with add_to_cart if you need to refresh the checkout URL later. SEARCH TIPS: the catalog is keyword-matched, so query with concise PRODUCT terms — the core product type plus distinguishing attributes (e.g. "oil-free sunscreen", not "a sunscreen that won't break me out"). Pass price limits via minPrice/maxPrice and a retailer via merchantId rather than putting them in the query text. Drop conversational filler; generic/non-product words (e.g. "good", "professional", "that won't") can surface irrelevant items like books or music whose titles happen to contain those words.

OMIT on the first search; the response returns a sessionId — pass that SAME sessionId on every later search AND into add_to_cart / add_multiple_to_cart, so the shopper's searches and cart stay linked (this powers personalized recommendations on the checkout page).

tool.name: add_to_cart
tool.title: Add to Cart
tool.description: Add a single product (by UPC) to a Shoppable cart. Returns sessionId, itemCount, and an updated checkoutUrl. IMPORTANT for multi-item carts: each call without a sessionId creates a NEW separate cart, so the shopper would have to check out multiple times. If you are adding more than one item in the same conversation: (1) preferred — use add_multiple_to_cart with all UPCs in one call, or (2) pass the sessionId returned by your first add_to_cart call into every subsequent add_to_cart call. Always share the latest checkoutUrl with the shopper, not earlier ones.

tool.description: Remove a single product (by UPC) from a Shoppable cart. Pass the sessionId of the cart and the UPC of the item to remove — get the UPCs from get_cart_contents. tool.name: get_order
tool.title: Get Order
tool.description: Look up an order by order number. BEFORE calling this tool, ask the shopper for at least one of: the email address used on the order, the phone number on the order, the billing postal/zip code, or the last name on the order. Pass whatever they confirm as `email`, `phone`, `postalCode`, or `lastName`. The order is only returned if at least one of those matches what is on file; otherwise the response is identical to "order not found" so the existence of the order is not leaked. Never share the order number publicly — treat it as something only the shopper should know. (Legacy: orderId is accepted as an alias for orderNumber for older clients.)

_published_faq.name: How do I add Shoppable to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Shoppable to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.shoppable.com/claude.

_published_faq.name: Is Shoppable MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 6, 2026, Shoppable scores 90/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan does not yet meet ChatGPT publishing checks and meets Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: How clear is Shoppable's MCP tool documentation?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 6, 2026, Shoppable scores 88/100 in Manufact's review of tool titles, descriptions, input and output schemas, and behavior annotations. The review covers 13 of 13 discovered tools. The quality score measures documentation clarity; runtime behavior and marketplace readiness require separate checks.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Shoppable MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Shoppable provides these MCP tools: search_products, get_merchant, add_to_cart, add_multiple_to_cart, get_checkout_url, get_cart_contents, get_order, find_similar, get_deals, get_trending, list_categories, and list_brands.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Shoppable?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Shoppable in commerce-shopping on the Manufact MCP catalog include EbooksDepository, ecoExperten Energieausweis, PHS Pallets, Promotion Pros Catalog, and RCO-A2A.
Shoppable does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.

_published_faq.name: How can Shoppable improve its MCP documentation?

acceptedAnswer.text: list_categories is the lowest-scoring reviewed tool at 79/100. Clarify units, where to obtain this value, or conventions not already expressed in the schema. Open its review for feedback and a copyable fix prompt, then rerun the documentation review after updating your tool metadata.
Shoppable is developed by Shoppable. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
